messages:
lina: heads up: hitting weird client-side bursts on the sample onboarding flow. repro looks like: Go SDK flow serializes refresh, JS SDK does not, and our prefetch window is 3 pages -> overlapping retries and 429s. anyone seen this parity gap?

omar: interesting. so Go has singleflight for token refresh but JS still uses naive if (401) refresh -> retry. can you paste a short trace?

lina: sure — simplified: 
```
fetch page1 -> 401 -> trigger refresh (A)
fetch page2 -> 200
fetch page3 -> 401 -> trigger refresh (B)
refresh A completes -> retry page1
refresh B completes -> retry page3
now we have several retried inflight requests + prefetch window=3 -> burst -> 429s
```

harry: that matches what QA observed in staging yesterday. we saw concentrated 429s for /v1/content/list when multiple new users hit import at the same minute.

qa: repro steps: enable onboarding prefetch=3 in sampleapp, run 10 simulated users, 40% hit token expiry path. 429s spike within 60s.

omar: short-term mitigation: reduce prefetch window to 1 or 2, add client-side request coalescing for identical cursor requests, and honor Retry-After before retries. medium-term: push a JS SDK patch that mirrors Go's single-flight token refresh helper.

lina: ok i'll flip prefetch to 1 behind the feature flag and add a tiny in-app request cache keyed by cursor+session for 5s. that should suppress duplicates while we fix SDK.

harry: when you do the SDK change, please keep the API backward compatible. maybe export `sdk.token.getOrRefresh()` which returns the token and ensures a single inflight refresh per user id. also add a small opt-in flag `client.requestDedup=true` to the sample app.

omar: agreed. tests: add unit for concurrent refresh calls and an integration test simulating 50 concurrent page requests across 10 sessions. can we add a chaos test that randomly delays refresh completion to exercise the retry logic?

qa: yes. i'll add that to the staging test harness. also add a metric `dx.client.duplicate_requests` so we can quantify the improvement.

lina: PR plan: 1) sampleapp: prefetch=1 + 5s cursor cache + opt-in dedupe, 2) js-sdk: single-flight token helper + tests, 3) docs update in quickstart about safe prefetch defaults. will roll to 10% in staging.

omar: add exponential backoff with jitter for client retries too. cap to 3 attempts.

devx-bot: Deploy triggered: sampleapp/onboard-dedupe-rollout -> canary (job #9021).

harry: once deployed, QA will run the load script and compare `dx.client.duplicate_requests` pre/post. if drop > 70% we can bump rollout.

lina: sweet. i'll open the SDK PR and link it here. thx! :raised_hands:
